record.name: Front
record.one_liner: Shared inbox and customer operations platform for customer support and sales teams.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free developer account to access a developer environment.
record.api_note: The Core API covers conversations, channels, contacts, messages, and automation.

evidence.quote: Front supports OAuth2.0 as well as API Tokens.
You’ll get access to a free developer environment that will provide everything you need to begin building with our APIs.
The Core API allows you as a Front developer to access core data and actions within Front.
We're excited to announce the beta release of the Front MCP server
You can create a developer account by signing up here.
